## What does this change?

<!-- One or two sentences. Link the issue it closes: "Closes #123". -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Content: a verse, an explanation, a note, or page copy
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature or improvement
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Other (tooling, dependencies, CI)

## For content changes

- Verses touched: <!-- e.g. 13, 27 -->
- What did you check the meaning against? <!-- an edition, your own reading of Elu, a scholar. Honest uncertainty is welcome. -->
- [ ] I wrote this in my own words and did not copy a printed edition, commentary or someone's translation
- [ ] I read the [content style guide](../docs/content-style-guide.md)
- [ ] If I am unsure of a verse, it stays in `APPROXIMATE`; if I removed one, I explained why I am confident

## For code changes

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] I tried it in the browser, including with **Calm mode** on and on a smaller screen
- [ ] It stays smooth on modest hardware (no per-frame React state, geometry and materials are reused)
- [ ] Keyboard use, focus rings and `lang` attributes still work
- [ ] Screenshots or a short recording are attached for anything visual
